node.statement: Explicit rectification step: with phi from node 1.1, define d_L(y)=y-I_X y, d_R(x)=x-x I_X, h=I_X I_X-I_X, m_0(x,y)=xy+phi(x)d_L(y)+phi(y)d_R(x)+phi(x)phi(y)h, J=I_X/a, and x bold-dot y=a m_0(x,y); then bold-dot is bilinear, J=J^dagger is its exact two-sided unit with ||J||=1, and the involution is exactly anti-multiplicative for bold-dot.
